dedupe_keys.name: sewa hourly and daily electricity demand with weather 2020 2021

description: This SEWA deposit combines Sharjah electricity-demand metrics for 2020 and 2021 with hourly weather variables and daily summaries. The research collaborators include minimum and peak load, hourly energy, temperature, humidity, wind speed, solar irradiance and previous-hour demand. Mendeley version 2 contains an Excel workbook named for the checked 2020–2021 data and a separate workbook labelled as predicted demand for 2023–2024. Both are publicly accessible free under CC BY 4.0. The predicted workbook must be distinguished from historical observations; its filename alone does not verify forecast method or accuracy. Geographic coverage is the SEWA service context, not the separate University of Sharjah M5 smart-building dataset already in the catalogue. A reviewer-assessed use is checking weather-sensitive load forecasts and demand scenarios for electricity planning simulations. model-pypsa is a related planning tool, with no verified direct workbook import. No cells were read and no forecast performance was recalculated.
name: SEWA hourly and daily electricity demand with weather, 2020–2021
notes: G2-0115. Metadata only. Proposed simulation uses are reviewer assessments. No dataset, model or article PDF downloaded; no program executed.
